seo.title: Payment
seo.description: Choose a currency and payment method to complete your order from Arafat Bin Wahahid's shop.

hero.title: Payment
hero.text: Choose a currency and a payment method, pay, then send the confirmation form.

noscript: This page needs JavaScript to show your cart. Please turn JavaScript on, or order on WhatsApp.
stockNotice: Some quantities were changed to match the stock that is available now.

empty.title: Your cart is empty
empty.text: Add products from the shop first.

missingDetails: Some payment details are not listed here yet. Message us on WhatsApp and we will send them.
verifyNote: Sending this form does not mark your order as paid. We check every payment by hand, then confirm your order by email or WhatsApp.

form.invalidPhone: Please enter a valid mobile number, for example +968 9213 0528.
form.invalidAmount: Please enter the amount you paid.
form.invalidDate: Please choose today or a later date.
form.invalidTime: Please choose a time within the available hours.
form.duplicate: This order was already sent. Order ID: {id}
form.error: Could not send. Please try again, or message us on WhatsApp with your order ID {id}.

done.title: Thank you!
done.payment: We received your payment confirmation for order {id}. We will check the payment and contact you soon.
done.appointment: We received your appointment request for order {id}. We will confirm the date and time with you soon.
